edges.reason: The pair constructor assigns factory = msg.sender, making the deployer the privileged factory.
constructor writes the privileged factory state variable from the untrusted caller.
initialize is guarded by require(msg.sender == factory).
The factory state variable is the authority checked by initialize.
token0 can only be written through the factory-restricted initialize.
token1 can only be written through the factory-restricted initialize.
setFeeTo requires msg.sender == feeToSetter.
setFeeTo writes the feeTo address later consumed by _mintFee.
setFeeToSetter requires msg.sender == feeToSetter.
setFeeToSetter transfers the privileged feeToSetter role.
feeToSetter is the authority compared in setFeeTo.
permit requires deadline >= block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
_update derives blockTimestamp from block.timestamp for price accumulation.
blockTimestampLast is refreshed from block.timestamp.
price0CumulativeLast += price * timeElapsed; overflow is intentional and unchecked.
price1CumulativeLast += price * timeElapsed; overflow is intentional and unchecked.
permit recovers the signer address with ecrecover.
After signature verification permit writes allowance on behalf of owner.
swap invokes IUniswapV2Callee(to).uniswapV2Call before reading post-swap balances.
The attacker-controlled callback can re-enter the pair; only the lock modifier prevents nested state mutation.
msg.sender is forwarded as the sender argument of the reentering callback.
The lock modifier on swap sets unlocked = 0 to block reentrancy.
The lock modifier guards mint with the unlocked flag.
The lock modifier guards burn with the unlocked flag.
_safeTransfer executes a low-level token.call with a hardcoded transfer selector.
swap optimistically sends output tokens through _safeTransfer.
burn sends the underlying tokens out through _safeTransfer.
skim sends excess balances through _safeTransfer.
amount0/amount1 are computed by dividing by _totalSupply inside burn.
swap checks the 1000-scaled invariant balance0Adjusted*balance1Adjusted >= reserve0*reserve1*1000**2.
createPair deploys the pair with create2 and a salt derived from both tokens.
createPair performs an external call to the freshly deployed pair (initialize).
The factory owns the admin setters reachable from the same contract.
transferFrom spends allowance[from][msg.sender], keyed on the untrusted caller.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom delegates balance updates to _transfer.
mint creates LP tokens through _mint.
burn destroys LP tokens through _burn.
_mint performs totalSupply = totalSupply.add(value) with SafeMath checks.
_burn performs totalSupply = totalSupply.sub(value) with SafeMath checks.
_mint credits balanceOf[to] with SafeMath addition.
_burn debits balanceOf[from] with SafeMath subtraction.
mint finalises with _update(balance0, balance1, _reserve0, _reserve1).
burn re-reads balances and calls _update.
sync forces _update with the current balances.
mint calls _mintFee before computing the new liquidity.
burn calls _mintFee before computing payout amounts.
_mintFee reads the privileged feeTo address from the factory.
_mintFee reads and, on fee-off, resets kLast.
mint reads cached reserves via getReserves.
burn reads cached reserves via getReserves.
swap reads cached reserves via getReserves before transferring.
getReserves returns reserve0.
getReserves returns reserve1.
getReserves returns blockTimestampLast.
_update writes the truncated balance0 into reserve0.
_update writes the truncated balance1 into reserve1.

normalization_plan.reason: The to parameter is the destination of _safeTransfer in burn, swap and skim.
amount0Out is consumed by swap to size the optimistic token0 transfer.
amount1Out is consumed by swap to size the optimistic token1 transfer.
data is forwarded verbatim into the attacker-controlled uniswapV2Call callback.
owner is the claimed signer checked inside permit.
spender is stored in the allowance mapping by _approve.
value is the allowance amount written by _approve.
deadline is compared against block.timestamp inside permit.
tokenA is an argument of createPair used for ordering and the create2 salt.
tokenB is an argument of createPair used for ordering and the create2 salt.
_feeTo is the new fee recipient assigned by the privileged setFeeTo.
_token0/_token1 are written to the pair state by the factory-restricted initialize.
from keys the allowance lookup performed by transferFrom.
_feeToSetter receives the privileged role in setFeeToSetter.
blockTimestamp is the uint32 truncation of block.timestamp used by _update.
timeElapsed drives the cumulative price increments inside _update.
balance0 is the post-transfer balance written into reserve0 by _update.
balance1 is the post-transfer balance written into reserve1 by _update.
amount0 is the deposited token0 amount computed in mint.
amount1 is the deposited token1 amount computed in mint.
liquidity is the LP amount computed and minted in mint.
feeOn is the protocol-fee flag determined in _mintFee.
rootK is the square root of k used for the fee mint calculation.
digest is the EIP-712 hash supplied to ecrecover in permit.
recoveredAddress is the ecrecover output validated against owner.
pair is the address returned by the create2 opcode in createPair.
